ceterms:description.en-US: Introductory programming course for students majoring in computer science or computer engineering. Software development process: problem specification, program design, implementation, testing and documentation. Programming topics: data representation, conditional and iterative statements, functions, arrays, strings, file I/O and classes. Using C++ in a UNIX environment. Corequisite: Lab component. Prerequisite: MATH 24005 or MATH 24004 each with a grade of C or better, and must be a student in ENGR, ENGRFR, EXPLEN, MATHBS, MATHBA, or CSCE-Minor. (Typically offered: Fall and Spring)

languageModel.name: qwen3.5:9b
languageModel.argument: The sentence contains the conjunction 'and' connecting two main clauses: (1) taking specific math courses with a grade requirement, and (2) being a student in specific departments. According to the CTDL definition of ceterms:requires, this implies an 'all_of' structure where every item must be satisfied. The first clause uses 'or' between 'MATH 24005' and 'MATH 24004 each with a grade of C or better', which aligns with the CTDL definition of ceterms:alternativeCondition, creating an 'any_of' structure where satisfying either path fulfills that part of the requirement. The second clause lists specific departments joined by commas and 'or', which is interpreted as a single text condition describing the group of eligible students.
